auth.forgot_password_description: Forgot your password? No problem. Just let us know your email address and we will email you a password reset link that will allow you to choose a new one.
auth.confirm_password_description: This is a secure area of the application. Please confirm your password before continuing.
auth.email_verification_description: Thanks for signing up! Before getting started, could you verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you? If you didn't receive the email, we will gladly send you another.
auth.verification_link_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.

profile.delete_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its resources and data will be permanently deleted. Before deleting your account, please download any data or information that you wish to retain.

profile.sign_in_method_description: How you authenticate to this account.

profile.no_subscriptions: You are not connected to any entities yet.

submit.title_placeholder: Give your slide a descriptive title

overlay_editor.external_notice: This slide already has an overlay that wasn't made in this editor. Keep it as a fixed base layer to build on, or start blank (saving will replace it).
overlay_editor.too_large: This overlay is too large to save. Try smaller or fewer images.
overlay_editor.image_too_large: That image is too large, even after resizing. Try a smaller file.
overlay_editor.confirm_remove: All layers have been removed. Remove this slide's overlay?
overlay_editor.canvas_hint: Drag to move, drag the handles to resize (Shift toggles keeping proportions). Arrow keys nudge; Delete removes.
overlay_editor.no_layers: No layers yet — add a QR code, text, shape or image.
overlay_editor.select_hint: Select a layer to edit it.
overlay_editor.locked_hint: This layer is locked. Unlock it in the layer list to move or resize it.
overlay_editor.imported_hint: Artwork imported from an SVG file. It's kept exactly as imported.
overlay_editor.qr_no_link: No link set — add one on the Details tab.
overlay_editor.qr_canonical_local_hint: Local slides only open for signed-in members; other people who scan it will land on the home page.
overlay_editor.qr_error_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid web address.
overlay_editor.qr_error_scheme: Only http:// and https:// addresses are supported.
overlay_editor.qr_long_url: Long addresses make dense codes that are harder to scan from a distance.
overlay_editor.qr_trackers_removed: Tracking removed ({params}). The code will open:
overlay_editor.qr_transparent_hint: Without a light background, the code may not scan over dark or busy parts of the slide.
overlay_editor.qr_failed: Couldn't generate a code for this address.
overlay_editor.widget_hint: Widgets always appear above the other layers, and run live when the slide is shown.
overlay_editor.widget_missing_hint: The "{slug}" widget is no longer installed. Remove this layer to save the overlay.
overlay_editor.widget_disabled_hint: An administrator has turned this widget off, so it won't show on screens until it's turned back on.

qr_code.title: QR Code Creator
qr_code.intro: Paste a web address, style your code, and download it. Everything happens in your browser.
qr_code.export_failed: The PNG couldn't be created. Try the SVG download instead.
qr_code.format_hint: SVG stays sharp at any size (best for print); PNG works everywhere.

admin_widgets.install_description: Upload a widget package (.zip with a {manifest}). Uploading a newer version of an installed widget upgrades it everywhere it's used.
admin_widgets.trust_warning: A widget's code runs in the browser of everyone who views a slide that uses it, with their signed-in session. Only install widgets you trust.
admin_widgets.default_location_description: Widgets that follow each screen's location (for example a Weather widget with its ZIP code left blank) use the screen's church's location. Screens whose church has no coordinates, and pages with no church, use this location instead. Leave it empty to show nothing there.
admin_widgets.extra_addresses_hint: Built in: {list}. Add one https:// prefix per line (for example a church management system's calendar feed address).
admin_widgets.remove_usage: It's placed on {n} slide overlay(s), which will show nothing there.

show_manage.archive_confirm: Archive "{title}"? It will stop showing right away — you can restore it later from the archive.
show_manage.remove_expired_confirm: Remove {n} expired slide from "{show}"? | Remove {n} expired slides from "{show}"?
show_manage.delete_show_confirm: Delete the show "{show}"? This can't be undone.
show_manage.language_filter_hint: Only changes what's shown on this page — every show holds all languages
show_manage.title: Title
show_manage.video_hold_last_frame: Hold last frame until slide delay
show_manage.description_placeholder: Shown alongside the slide, e.g. event details…
show_manage.add_to_none: Do not add to any show
show_manage.share_nearby_info: Local slide sharing allows you to promote events and ministries relevant to others in your local area. Ensure that your slide contains all relevant information such as the date and time, and the specific address of the event. Please share any events you would invite the public to, but don't share weekly announcements such as regular potluck, regular weekly services, other events specifically for local members. Refrain from sharing generic greetings or anything not specifically tied to an event.
show_manage.share_nearby_quality: Shared slides must meet the image quality requirements.
show_manage.media_download_failed: The image could not be downloaded.
show_manage.media_compress_no_gain: Re-encoding as JPEG would not make this file smaller.
show_manage.media_undo_title: Go back to the image as it was uploaded
show_manage.media_hint_upscale: Double the resolution with AI (the original is kept)
show_manage.media_hint_downscale: Shrink to fit 4K (the original is kept)
show_manage.media_hint_compress: Re-encode as JPEG to get under the file-size limit (the original is kept)
show_manage.media_keep_one: A slide must keep at least one Slide file

slide_announcers.unpair_confirm: Unpair "{name}"? It will need a fresh pairing code to reconnect.
slide_announcers.etcher_help_entity: Write one of these directly to an SD card (with {etcher} or similar) to provision a new device, then pair it with the code above.
slide_announcers.pairing_instructions: — enter this on the device's pairing screen. Expires {time}.
slide_announcers.no_images: No OS disk images have been published yet.
slide_announcers.no_devices: No Slide Announcer devices paired yet. Generate a pairing code and enter it on the device's setup screen.
slide_announcers.video_hold_last_frame: Hold last frame until slide delay
slide_announcers.name: Name
slide_announcers.language_help: Filters which language-specific slides sync to this device, and sets its on-screen UI language. Leave unset to fall back to the language configured on the device itself before pairing.
slide_announcers.slide_duration_help: How long each slide stays on screen before switching to the next.
slide_announcers.lan_help: Lets a video switcher or encoder on this church's network (OBS, vMix, etc.) send a live feed to this device over SRT or RIST. It also has to be switched on in the device's own Settings > Advanced.
slide_announcers.lan_allow_help: Unchecking force-disables it, overriding the device's own switch.
slide_announcers.lan_pending: Saved — waiting for the device to apply these settings (it checks in about once a minute).
slide_announcers.lan_apply_error: The device couldn't apply the last change: {error}
slide_announcers.lan_local_off: Currently switched off on the device itself (Settings > Advanced).
slide_announcers.rist_unsupported: This device's software doesn't support RIST.
slide_announcers.passphrase_help: 10–79 characters, no spaces. Shared by SRT and RIST Unicast.
slide_announcers.multicast_wifi_warning: Multicast over WiFi is not recommended — connect this device by Ethernet.
slide_announcers.pin_help: 4-6 digits. When set, opening Settings on the device requires this PIN first (leave blank to disable).
slide_announcers.pin_error: Settings PIN must be 4-6 digits, or blank to disable.
slide_announcers.custom_settings_hint: (JSON — sent to the device with every slide sync)
slide_announcers.search_placeholder: Search by device or site name…
slide_announcers.required_base_help: Only applies on top of a device already at this exact version.
slide_announcers.tag_help: Tagging moves that channel off whatever release currently holds it for this kind+architecture — it doesn't remove any other tags this release might also get later.
slide_announcers.no_current: No releases currently tagged on any channel.
slide_announcers.archived_note: Not tagged on any channel — still downloadable at their same URL.
slide_announcers.tag_warning: This removes it from {kind} {version} ({arch}), which currently holds that tag.
slide_announcers.archived_untagged: Archived — not tagged on any channel.
slide_announcers.etcher_help_admin: You can write this image directly to an SD card to provision Slide Announcer on a new device. Use {etcher} or similar software to write this image.
slide_announcers.compat_aarch64: This image is compatible with Raspberry Pi 3 or newer (suggested 2GB or more RAM).

upscaler.description: Slide images between {min} and {max} can be doubled in resolution by an AI model that runs in the browser of the person uploading (needs a GPU-accelerated browser; the first use downloads the model). The original image is always kept so an upscale can be undone.
upscaler.enable_hint: Off hides every upscale option (existing upscaled images keep working).
upscaler.auto_on_upload_hint: The upload form ticks "Upscale 2× with AI" for eligible images; uploaders can untick it.
upscaler.jpeg_quality_hint: Upscaled images are saved as JPEG. If a result is over the 5 MB size limit it is re-encoded at lower quality (down to 80%) automatically.
upscaler.tile_size_hint: Images are processed in tiles. Smaller tiles use less GPU memory (fewer failures on weak computers) but take longer.
upscaler.shrink: Shrink oversized images: larger than {size} (4K) or over 5 MB
upscaler.shrink_hint: Images beyond 4K are downscaled to fit it, and files over 5 MB (such as a large PNG) are re-encoded as JPEG, both in the uploader's browser (no AI, same JPEG quality as above). The original is kept so it can be undone. Independent of "Enable upscaling".
upscaler.try_description: Upscale an image on your computer with any model to compare them. Nothing is uploaded or saved. It uses the quality and tile size above (even if unsaved).
upscaler.not_an_image: That file is not an image the browser can read.
